newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes down on importers' activity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes down on importers' activity.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed lower against the U.S. dollar on Monday as local importers bought the U.S. unit to meet month-end commercial demand, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.521 against Saturday's T$27.510 close. Turnover through dealers was a modest US$177 million.
Dealers said the rate was likely to stay stuck in directionless trade for the time being.
"It is hard to tell which way the rate is heading. The market's supply and demand are fairly balanced," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said foreign equity funds likely would continue to flow into Taiwan to enter the sizzling stock market, which vaulted on Monday to a yet another in a series of six-year highs.
Dealers saw a stable T$27.50-53 trading range for Tuesday.
